name: Awesome Claude Design
summary: 68 ready-to-use DESIGN.md files that Claude Design expands into a full UI scaffold in one shot.
description: A collection of 68 DESIGN.md files, each describing one brand-inspired design system — visual theme, color palette, typography, component stylings, layout, depth, do's and don'ts, responsive behaviour and an agent prompt guide — in a format design agents can act on. Upload one to Claude Design and it scaffolds tokens, preview cards and a working UI kit with a SKILL.md. Systems span AI & LLM platforms, developer tools, fintech, e-commerce, media and automotive brands.
contains: groups: AI, dev tools, backend/DevOps, productivity, design tools, fintech, e-commerce, media, automotive

Claude Design output: README, CSS variables, preview cards, UI kit and SKILL.md
